source_urls.title: Immunity Therapy Center (ITC) – Alternative Cancer Treatment
source_urls.overview: Immunity Therapy Center (ITC) in Tijuana, Mexico specializes in customized, holistic, and non-toxic alternative cancer treatments. The facility provides over 30 individualized alternative and integrative therapies aimed at boosting natural immune defenses, attacking cancer cells, and maintaining high quality of life without aggressive chemotherapy side effects.
source_urls.facilities: State-of-the-art alternative clinic located minutes from the San Diego, California border. Equipped with specialized therapy suites, clinical lab facilities, on-site dining for medical nutrition, and dedicated nursing care with two nurses per station.
source_urls.conditions_treated: Various types and stages of cancer including adenocarcinoma, adrenal cancer, anal cancer, breast cancer, colorectal, prostate, lung, and stomach cancers, as well as chronic autoimmune and infectious conditions.
source_urls.key_therapies: Whole-body and localized hyperthermia, high-dose intravenous Vitamin C and mineral infusions, ozone therapy, oxygen therapy (hyperbaric oxygen), targeted immunotherapy protocols, sonodynamic therapy, and medical nutritional therapy.

source_urls.title: Alternative Adenocarcinoma Cancer Treatment Package in Tijuana, Mexico by ITC
source_urls.target_condition: Adenocarcinoma (Glandular cancers affecting lung, colon, breast, prostate, pancreas, or stomach)
source_urls.duration: Standard 3-week comprehensive program (additional weeks available as evaluated by medical staff)

pricing.pricing_context: Starting from $18,995 USD for outpatient 3-week program; $30,000 USD for 24/7 residential inpatient care. Extra weeks start from $5,600 USD/week if recommended.

inclusions: Initial comprehensive medical consultation & personalized treatment planning
Daily doctor consultations and continuous clinical monitoring during treatment days
Weekly blood work, lab testing, and diagnostic imaging (ultrasound/x-ray as indicated)
Daily customized non-toxic alternative therapies (hyperthermia, IV therapy, oxygen therapy)
Two meals daily (breakfast and lunch) prepared by clinical nutritionists for outpatients (full board for inpatients)
Dedicated nursing staff in treatment rooms
Free airport transfers to/from San Diego International Airport (SAN) or Tijuana International Airport (TIJ)
Daily local transportation between partner hotels and the ITC clinic
exclusions: International airfare and flight travel to San Diego or Tijuana
Hotel lodging for outpatients (ITC assists with discounted rates at vetted partner hotels)
Specialized take-home medications, post-program supplement supplies, or external third-party prescriptions
source_urls.recovery_time: Because therapies are non-toxic, holistic, and minimally invasive, patients do not suffer conventional chemotherapy exhaustion. Patients generally feel stable during the 3-week protocol, with ongoing remote follow-up provided after returning home.

source_urls.title: Alternative Medicine Cost Abroad – Compare Prices 2026
source_urls.comparison_summary: Comprehensive benchmark comparing alternative medicine and integrative oncology costs across global destinations. Typical alternative oncology regimens in the United States and private European clinics frequently range between $50,000 and $80,000+ USD without travel coordination. In contrast, verified medical travel centers in Tijuana, Mexico like Immunity Therapy Center offer comprehensive 3-week protocols starting at $18,995 USD, delivering significant financial savings (typically 50% to 70% lower) with equal or greater personalized clinical attention.
source_urls.note_on_unlisted_countries: Pricing for alternative cancer treatments in other countries (such as Turkey, Germany, Thailand, or India) is not detailed on this specific ITC page set; patients inquiring about those destinations must request a custom comparative quote via PlacidWay.
